      "evidence": "Labeled Kernel, adds btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and separates nondeterministic clock symbols from libbitcoinkernel.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Decoupling libbitcoinkernel from the global system clock allows callers to run validation deterministically in concurrent instances without global state. PR description notes this provides an instance-scoped API so 'kernel applications run validation code deterministically without depending on the system clock'."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h are mechanical type updates to use NodeClock::time_point rather than changes to mempool acceptance or eviction policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change updates time types across mempool data structures mechanically to match clock refactoring without modifying policy logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touch to src/rpc/mempool.cpp (+1/-1) is a one-line mechanical type update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A trivial call-site update in RPC does not constitute a change to the RPC interface or behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes adapt existing harnesses to the clock API or fix area-specific validation test races rather than test harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Edits in test files are either mechanical call-site fixes across fuzz/bench harnesses or validation tests that belong to the validation area."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/util/time.h, src/util/time.cpp, and adds src/util/time_nondet.cpp to separate deterministic and nondeterministic time utilities.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Splitting nondeterministic clock calls into a separate translation unit prevents accidental link-time inclusion in deterministic libraries. It establishes a cleaner internal boundary for time utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Validation, modifies ChainstateManager time routing in src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h for header checks and IBD status.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Routes validation time checks through ChainstateManager::Now() and fixes a flaky test failure across second boundaries in chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks. Reviewers must confirm consensus and IBD time checks behave identically when scoped to chainstate."
